method: Read-only native admission observer on seed 1, both tiers, extended to 300 seconds so the route enters collapse. It records actual admissions by edge for each announced 9-second collapse cohort, population, cap reservations, and escape windows.

evidence.what: I inspected the native admission ledger. Both tiers open a 40-second escape gap and retain the authored 9-second wave schedule. In later 9-second windows low admitted 4, 2, 1, 4, 4, 5, 6 actual bodies; high admitted 9, 4, 2, 5, 3, 3, 3. Thus both tiers contain a complete window below the minimum 3 admissions. High reached the unchanged 120 infected cap with 44 reserved slots while collapse demand remained pending.

whyOpen: At least one full 9-second window per tier misses 3 actual admissions. A safe fix needs a design decision about freeing live population capacity while preserving the current caps and pending threat; changing caps, wave sizes, or the criterion is not supported by this evidence.
